implementation_slices.owns: Deterministically generate one immutable Product Model Snapshot from exact semantic source bytes and preserve the bound source epoch.
Expose the snapshot through one read-only local runtime query without persistence, mutation, network, or admission effects.
Add a clean Product Model route with four typed collections, searchable navigation, detail provenance, and no edit controls.

acceptance_obligations: The projection is generated from exact bound semantic sources; manually duplicated product meaning in React or runtime code is forbidden.
Every visible record preserves a stable ID, semantic kind, status, meaning, owner route, provenance, boundary, claim ceiling, and the snapshot source epoch.
Definitions, products, projects, and ontologies remain separate typed collections and are never collapsed into one generic authority-free card list.
The interface exposes only InspectProductModel; no create, update, delete, accept, register, publish, or ontology-runtime operation is added.
The Product Model route introduces no persistence write, network request, dependency, account, collaboration, publication, deployment, or external synchronization surface.
The existing essay-writing lifecycle, accepted local state, Milkdown boundary, and export behavior remain unchanged.
Source-generation checks, typecheck, unit tests, DomainSpec deterministic recompilation, package validation, production build, and browser accessibility acceptance pass.

Frontend copy distinguishes candidate, projected, generated, and accepted states and never claims that visibility proves admission, conformance, product value, or currentness beyond the displayed epoch.
challenge_route: Challenge semantic content through its displayed owner route, the projection contract through the Essays Product Capability owner, system mappings through the DomainSpec and bridge owners, and UI behavior through the Essays runtime owner.
drift_rule: Any change to semantic bindings, system bindings, planned files, dependency effects, implementation slices, or acceptance obligations creates a new baseline digest and requires renewed owner acceptance.
claim_ceiling: Immutable semantic-explorer implementation admission candidate only; no runtime mutation, implementation, conformance, adoption, publication, release, deployment, or external effect is authorized until the exact baseline digest is owner-accepted.
